observations.units: Pressure in bar, stated by format field 1. The abundance unit is not stated by the PDS3 label, by MWR_J_NH3A_V01.FMT, or by the dataset catalogue, whose Parameters section reads TBD. The archive names LI_ETAL_2017 as the retrieval algorithm and that document reports volume mixing ratios, so the values are carried as dimensionless. The retained abundance spans 3.2796e-08 to 4.2688e-04 and its 1-sigma uncertainty 3.0641e-09 to 3.9883e-05.
observations.meaning: Archive-published Juno MWR level-5 ammonia abundance on 548 pressure levels from 0.101395 to 198.082 bar by 37 planetocentric latitudes from -49.3 to +47.0 degrees, paired cell for cell with the archive 1-sigma uncertainty table. The dataset catalogue states that rows increase in pressure, that columns increase in planetocentric latitude, and that the recorded latitude is determined with SPICE.
observations.citation: LEVIN, S. M., JUNO JUPITER MWR AMMONIA DISTRIBUTION V1.0, JNO-J-MWR-5-NH3-DISTRIBUTION-V1.0, NASA Planetary Data System, 2024; https://atmos.nmsu.edu/PDS/data/jnomwr_2100/CATALOG/DATASET_NH3_DISTRIBUTION.CAT
limitations: This is a published retrieval derived from calibrated MWR observations, not a direct measurement of ammonia at each pressure level. The dataset catalogue names the archived LI_ETAL_2017 document as the algorithm and supplies no numerical retrieval code.
Pressure is retained as pressure. The product supplies no altitude, radius, or hydrostatic model, so no depth conversion and no body attachment is published.

The product carries no longitude coordinate, no channel identity, and no brightness temperature. The antenna- and brightness-temperature datasets of the same volume hold those and are not part of this product.
The archive states no unit for the abundance columns. Dimensionless volume mixing ratio is inferred from the cited algorithm document, not read from the label.

The dataset catalogue leaves Parameters, Data Coverage and Quality, and the Confidence Level Overview at TBD and records no known limitations, so no per-cell quality flag, retrieval-support mask, or retrieval resolution is available. Pressure and latitude spacing is sampling only.
Fields 21 to 38 of MWR_J_NH3U_V01.FMT are named MH3U_PC_lat_* rather than NH3U_PC_lat_*. Columns are taken from FIELD_NUMBER and DESCRIPTION, which stay consistent with the spreadsheet header.
